name: C++ for AI: LibTorch, ONNX Runtime, TensorRT and CUDA Integration
description: Expert C++ for AI inference: exporting PyTorch models for C++ with torch.export and AOTInductor, LibTorch, the ONNX Runtime C++ API, building and running TensorRT engines, writing CUDA kernels and custom plugins, and designing concurrent, memory-safe inference services with measured performance.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: C++ for AI: LibTorch, ONNX Runtime, TensorRT and CUDA Integration

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 21 lessons in 6 modules; and pass the final exam: 25 questions, 60 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
